channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Guggenheim Fellowship 2027
    https://www.gf.org/program/how-to-apply/
    John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Variable cash grant sized to the applicant's proposed budget and needs; the Foundation does not publish a fixed figure or range, and recent awards have typically run into the tens of thousands of US dollars. Roughly 175 to 200 fellowships are awarded each year across more than 50 fields. The Foundation charges no application fee and has no affiliated application consultants.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 4 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Youth Music: Trailblazer Fund (Round 13)
    https://www.youthmusic.org.uk/funding/i-need-funding/trailblazer-fund
    Youth Music · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 for organisations in England. No application fee.
  • Arts Council England: Music Growth Fund, GBP 1,000-40,000 strand
    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/music-growth-package/music-growth-fund-general-guidance
    Arts Council England · deadline Closed 03 Sep 2026 · GBP 1,000 to GBP 40,000, from a total annual budget of GBP 3,000,000 for this strand in 2026/27. You must find at least 25 percent of the total project budget as CASH match funding. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

    https://www.blackbird.foundation/protostars

item.title: 5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:

    Goethe-Institut (with Expertise France and Institut francais) · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · Up to EUR 4,000 per mobility. Eligible costs: travel (including visa and insurance), accommodation, subsistence, digital costs, and top-up support for family, disability, and green mobility. No application fee.
  • Emergence Art+Science Fellowships: Open Call for New Commissions (Emergence Festival 2027)
    https://www.d-iep.org/artsciencefellowships
    Emergence at All Scales (EAAS), with The Science & Cocktails Foundation, Stichting Paradiso and NWA Route Kunst · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Production budget up to EUR 20,000 including VAT per project (covers artist fees, materials, equipment, space, travel, accommodation, installation and presentation). Total call budget EUR 80,000 (around four projects). No application fee.
  • A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Programme Autumn 2027 (Chengdu)
    https://www.a4artmuseum.com/en/a4-residencyartcenter/residing/latest-recruitment/
    A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Studio and accommodation provided; round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget; production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for creative production and material costs (excluding living expenses). No application fee.
  • (Perma)culture Open Call 2026 (Ceske Budejovice 2028 European Capital of Culture)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdTTlZOjtEvvtKrkisZxHKecf2flkMl27a7-NeEkRVswjHGuQ/viewform
    Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · Large projects: support up to CZK 4,000,000 (approx. EUR 160,000), min budget CZK 2,200,000, max 50% of total costs. Small projects: support up to CZK 1,500,000 (approx. EUR 60,000), min budget CZK 750,000, max 70% of total costs. Each project must include at least one international partner and at least one South Bohemian regional partner. Budget covers two years of preparation and implementation (2027 + 2028). No application fee.
  • Emergent Ventures (Mercatus Center): Grants for Individuals
    https://www.mercatus.org/emergent-ventures
    Mercatus Center, George Mason University · deadline Rolling / undated · Grant size is set per project and is not published (ranges from small fast grants to larger awards). No application fee.
